_note: Chad's email voice, v1 (2026-10-17). Read by vale-draft to shape Vale's drafts. Edit by hand; never learned from mail.
tone: Warm, direct and brief. Plain words, short paragraphs, no corporate filler. Friendly but never gushing. Says the answer first, then the reason if one is needed.
length: Usually 2 to 5 sentences. Longer only when the email asks several questions.
use: I'll get back to you by
avoid: I hope this email finds you well

register.client: Professional and reassuring. Confirms next steps and dates clearly. No internal details, no prices or commitments unless Chad's intent says so.
register.external: Friendly and to the point. Polite no's are short and kind.
register.internal: Casual and quick. First names, no sign-off formality needed.
